newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel H1 accounting loss 3.04 bln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel H1 accounting loss 3.04 bln Ffr.

text.p: Eurotunnel said on Monday its accounting loss for the first half of 1996, taking into account interest due but not paid, totalled 3,043 million francs, an improvement of 618 million on the same period in 1995.
Since March Eurotunnel has broken even at the operating level before financial charges and after operating expenses and investment, it said in a statement with its first half results.
The company has provisioned 3,710 million francs for interest due on its junior bank debt but unpaid since it froze payments on September 14, 1995.
Eurotunnel said in a statement current turnover forecasts were in line with the estimates of a 50 percent increase given in the 1995 annual report.
It added the sales increase would be achieved despite a slight decrease in the second half compared with the year-earlier period. This was due to progress made in the second half of 1995.
Interest and charges due for the first half of 1996 totalled 2,639 milllion francs. It said no further borrowings were needed at the moment.
